newsitem.title: USA: Pegasus sets 3 mln Class A share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus sets 3 mln Class A share IPO.

text.p: Pegasus Communication Corp said Thursday it plans to sell up to three million Class A common shares in its initial public offering.
The media and communications company, in an amended filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, said the offering is estimated to be priced between $14 and $16 per share.
The offering will be made through Lehman Brothers, BT Securities Corp, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp and Painewebber Inc, the company said.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option on 450,000 Class A shares.
Pegasus will have 9,084,509 common shares outstanding after the offer -- 4,600,704 Class A shares and 4,483,805 Class B shares, the filing said.
The Class A stock has been approved for listing on Nasdaq under the symbol "PGTV."
